boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain University of Miami
boards.description: Ten currently documented food destinations on or near the Coral Gables campus with evening availability; check the linked venue before heading out.

cards.title: Starbucks at Shalala Student Center
cards.subtitle: Shalala Student Center, University of Miami
cards.notes: Use the Shalala Student Center location for a campus-based evening stop, and confirm the day’s service before walking over.
cards.short_summary: An on-campus coffee and snack option documented until 11 p.m.
cards.evidence_claim: The University of Miami student conference page lists Starbucks at the Shalala Student Center as open until 11 p.m. on weekdays and weekends.
cards.source_title: 305MUN III — Our Campus
cards.access_notes: Listed hours: 7 a.m.–11 p.m. weekdays; 8 a.m.–11 p.m. Saturdays and Sundays. Hours can change.

cards.title: Subway at Hurricane Food Court
cards.subtitle: Whitten University Center, University of Miami
cards.notes: Head to the Hurricane Food Court for a straightforward late-evening meal option; verify operations for holidays and academic breaks.
cards.short_summary: A campus sandwich counter with documented 10 p.m. closing hours.
cards.evidence_claim: The University of Miami student conference page lists Subway as open until 10 p.m. on weekdays and weekends.
cards.source_title: 305MUN III — Our Campus
cards.access_notes: Listed hours: 10 a.m.–10 p.m. weekdays; 11 a.m.–10 p.m. Saturdays and Sundays. Hours can change.

cards.title: SoCal at Hurricane Food Court
cards.subtitle: Whitten University Center, University of Miami
cards.notes: Use SoCal for an evening food-court stop on campus, and check the current dining schedule before making the trip.
cards.short_summary: A Hurricane Food Court option documented through 10 p.m.
cards.evidence_claim: The University of Miami student conference page lists SoCal as open until 10 p.m. on weekdays and weekends.
cards.source_title: 305MUN III — Our Campus
cards.access_notes: Listed hours: 11 a.m.–10 p.m. weekdays; 4–10 p.m. Saturdays and Sundays. Hours can change.

cards.title: The Market
cards.subtitle: University of Miami Coral Gables campus
cards.notes: Treat this as the campus convenience fallback for packaged food and basics; confirm access rules and selection at the location.
cards.short_summary: A campus market listed as operating 24/7.
cards.evidence_claim: The University of Miami student conference page lists The Market as open 24/7.
cards.source_title: 305MUN III — Our Campus
cards.access_notes: Listed as open 24/7; confirm building access and current operations before relying on it overnight.

cards.title: Market NXT
cards.subtitle: Whitten University Center, University of Miami
cards.notes: Use the checkout-free campus market for a late convenience stop; have an accepted mobile-payment method ready and check current access.
cards.short_summary: A University of Miami convenience store documented until midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: UM Dining’s official post says Market NXT in the Whitten University Center is open daily from 8 a.m. to midnight.
cards.source_title: UM Dining — Market NXT announcement
cards.access_notes: Official UM Dining post lists daily hours of 8 a.m.–12 a.m.; it says entry uses Grubhub or mobile pay.

cards.entity_name: Domino's Pizza — 5877 Ponce De Leon Blvd
cards.title: Domino's Pizza on Ponce
cards.subtitle: 5877 Ponce De Leon Blvd, Coral Gables
cards.notes: Order carryout or delivery from this Ponce location when campus options have closed, then verify the live store status before leaving.
cards.short_summary: A nearby pizza shop whose official listing shows midnight availability.
cards.evidence_claim: Domino’s official location page identifies the 5877 Ponce De Leon Boulevard store and shows it open until 12 a.m.
cards.source_title: Domino's Pizza — 5877 Ponce De Leon Blvd
cards.access_notes: Official location page showed “Open Today Until 12:00 AM” when checked; live hours vary by day.

cards.title: Shake Shack Coral Gables
cards.subtitle: 1450 S. Dixie Highway, Coral Gables
cards.notes: Use the South Dixie Highway location for a sit-down or takeout meal near campus, checking the official ordering page for the day’s hours.
cards.short_summary: A named fast-casual restaurant immediately beside the campus area.
cards.evidence_claim: Shake Shack’s official location page identifies its Coral Gables restaurant at 1450 S. Dixie Highway.
cards.source_title: Shake Shack — Coral Gables, FL
cards.access_notes: Check the official location page or ordering flow for current closing time before going.

cards.title: Graziano's Restaurant Coral Gables
cards.subtitle: 394 Giralda Ave, Coral Gables
cards.notes: Plan a Friday or Saturday dinner at the Giralda Avenue restaurant and confirm the kitchen’s same-day availability before traveling from campus.
cards.short_summary: An Argentine restaurant with official late Friday and Saturday hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Graziano’s official Coral Gables page lists restaurant hours until 11:30 p.m. on Fridays and Saturdays.
cards.source_title: Graziano's — Coral Gables
cards.access_notes: Official page lists restaurant hours until 11:30 p.m. Friday and Saturday; it lists earlier closing on other days.

cards.title: Luca Osteria
cards.subtitle: 116 Giralda Avenue, Coral Gables
cards.notes: Reserve or check availability for a Friday or Saturday dinner on Giralda Avenue, and use the restaurant’s posted kitchen schedule as the guide.
cards.short_summary: A Coral Gables Italian restaurant with an 11 p.m. weekend kitchen close.
cards.evidence_claim: Luca Osteria’s official site lists Friday and Saturday kitchen hours of 5:30–11 p.m.
cards.source_title: Luca Osteria — Location + Hours
cards.access_notes: Official site lists Friday and Saturday kitchen service until 11 p.m.; Tuesday–Thursday and Sunday end at 10 p.m.

cards.title: Americana Kitchen
cards.subtitle: Loews Coral Gables Hotel, Coral Gables
cards.notes: Use the hotel restaurant for a weekend dinner option and review the venue’s current dining details or reservation availability before heading out.
cards.short_summary: A hotel restaurant serving dinner until 11 p.m. on Fridays and Saturdays.
cards.evidence_claim: Loews Coral Gables lists Americana Kitchen dinner from 5–11 p.m. on Fridays and Saturdays.
cards.source_title: Loews Coral Gables — Dining
cards.access_notes: Official hotel page lists Friday and Saturday dinner through 11 p.m.; Sunday–Thursday dinner is listed through 10 p.m.

boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten named Coral Gables campus places for collaborative work, focused research, creative projects, and outdoor breaks.

cards.title: Otto G. Richter Library
cards.subtitle: Central library on the Coral Gables campus
cards.notes: Start at the central library when your plan needs research help, technology, collections, or a place to settle into academic work.
cards.short_summary: A central academic hub with study support, collections, and technology-rich services.
cards.evidence_claim: Richter Library is UM's central interdisciplinary library and provides the university community with study support, a Learning Commons, Creative Studio, and research services.
cards.source_title: Otto G. Richter Library
cards.access_notes: Check the library's current hours and access guidance before visiting.

cards.title: Learning Commons at Richter
cards.subtitle: First floor, Otto G. Richter Library
cards.notes: Use this first-floor hub to reserve a study space, find course materials, or connect with academic support services.
cards.short_summary: A shared first-floor academic-services space inside Richter Library.
cards.evidence_claim: The Learning Commons is on Richter Library's first floor and offers study-space reservations, equipment access, course materials, and academic-service connections.
cards.source_title: Welcome to the Learning Commons
cards.access_notes: Services and space availability can vary; use the library's reservation and appointment links as needed.

cards.title: Creative Studio
cards.subtitle: Otto G. Richter Library
cards.notes: Bring a digital project and use the studio’s available Mac or Windows workstation when its specialized software fits your work.
cards.short_summary: A library workspace equipped for digital media and software-based projects.
cards.evidence_claim: Richter's Creative Studio has Mac workstations and a Dell Windows computer, with priority for people needing the installed software or hardware.
cards.source_title: Creative Studio at Richter Library: Computers
cards.access_notes: Computer use is subject to studio policies and priority for specialized software or hardware needs.

cards.title: Richter Stack Tower
cards.subtitle: Floors 4–9, Otto G. Richter Library
cards.notes: Choose the tower when you need quiet individual study, and keep conversations and phone use low to respect the designated zone.
cards.short_summary: Upper library floors designated for quiet, individual study.
cards.evidence_claim: Richter's Stack Tower floors 4, 5, 6, 7, and 9 are designated for quiet, individual study.
cards.source_title: Study Zones
cards.access_notes: Keep phones on silent or vibrate and limit conversations in the quiet zone.

cards.entity_name: Kislak Center at the University of Miami
cards.title: Kislak Center
cards.subtitle: Ground floor, Otto G. Richter Library
cards.notes: Visit the gallery or plan a research session in the reading room when a primary-source project calls for special collections.
cards.short_summary: A special-collections center with exhibitions and a reading room for research.
cards.evidence_claim: The Kislak Center is on the ground floor of Richter Library, houses Special Collections and University Archives, and includes a gallery and reading room.
cards.source_title: Kislak Center: About
cards.access_notes: Research access and handling requirements may apply; review collection guidance before a materials visit.

cards.title: Cuban Heritage Collection Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Roberto C. Goizueta Pavilion, Richter Library
cards.notes: Book ahead when your work needs Cuban or diaspora primary sources, then request the materials you want to consult on site.
cards.short_summary: An appointment-based reading room for Cuban and diaspora research materials.
cards.evidence_claim: The Cuban Heritage Collection Reading Room is open for in-person research Monday through Friday by advance booking and seat reservation.
cards.source_title: Cuban Heritage Collection
cards.access_notes: Advance booking, seat reservation, and requested materials are required; review the collection's appointment instructions.

cards.title: Architecture Research Center
cards.subtitle: University of Miami School of Architecture
cards.notes: Use the ARC for architecture, urban-planning, and design research; reserve a study room or computer station when your project needs one.
cards.short_summary: A subject library for architecture and urban planning and design research.
cards.evidence_claim: The Architecture Research Center holds a core architecture and urban-planning-and-design collection and offers study-room booking and public computer stations.
cards.source_title: Architecture Research Center: Visitor Information
cards.access_notes: Visitor access, hours, and study-room reservations are governed by ARC policies; verify them before arrival.

cards.entity_name: Marta and Austin Weeks Music Library
cards.title: Weeks Music Library
cards.subtitle: University of Miami Coral Gables campus
cards.notes: Head here for music-focused work, then use the designated quiet areas or group rooms according to the library’s study-zone guidance.
cards.short_summary: A music library with designated quiet-study areas and group-study exceptions.
cards.evidence_claim: The Weeks Music Library's first-floor Listening Lab and second floor are quiet-study zones, except for group study rooms.
cards.source_title: Study Zones
cards.access_notes: Keep phones on silent or vibrate and limit conversations in designated quiet areas.

cards.title: Gifford Arboretum
cards.subtitle: Coral Gables campus landscape collection
cards.notes: Take a short outdoor reset while observing the labeled plant collection, or use the site as a starting point for plant-focused coursework.
cards.short_summary: A campus arboretum used for education and research as well as tropical-plant appreciation.
cards.evidence_claim: The Gifford Arboretum contains more than 650 trees and shrubs representing more than 500 species and is maintained for education and research.
cards.source_title: University of Miami Tree Care Plan
cards.access_notes: Use established campus paths and respect plantings, classes, and research activity.

cards.title: Butterfly Gardens
cards.subtitle: Along the Ibis Walking Trail near Gifford Arboretum
cards.notes: Walk the Ibis trail behind Eaton Residential College and pause at the garden to observe its plantings and visiting butterflies.
cards.short_summary: A campus living-laboratory garden along the Ibis Walking Trail.
cards.evidence_claim: The Butterfly Gardens are along the Ibis Walking Trail behind Eaton Residential College, next to the Gifford Arboretum, and serve as living laboratories.
cards.source_title: University of Miami Tree Care Plan
cards.access_notes: Stay on established paths and avoid disturbing plants, insects, or any teaching and research activity.

boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten University of Miami-listed activities with free admission or attendance; check each event page for registration and schedule updates.

cards.entity_name: CEPS William M. Hoeveler Ethics & Public Service Award Ceremony
cards.title: Attend the Hoeveler Award Ceremony
cards.subtitle: University of Miami School of Law · Oct. 29, 2026
cards.notes: Register through the University calendar, then attend the Center for Ethics and Public Service ceremony on the Coral Gables law campus.
cards.short_summary: A free campus ceremony recognizing public-service work.
cards.evidence_claim: The University calendar lists this Law Campus ceremony as a Free Event and asks attendees to register.
cards.source_title: CEPS William M. Hoeveler Ethics & Public Service Award Ceremony
cards.access_notes: Scheduled for Oct. 29, 2026 at 1311 Miller Rd. Registration is requested; confirm event details before going.

cards.entity_name: Latent Variable Modeling in the Behavioral Sciences | Yusuf Kara Lecture
cards.title: Hear the Yusuf Kara Lecture
cards.subtitle: Toll Library, Newman Alumni Center · Sept. 8, 2026
cards.notes: Register for the Institute for Data Science and Computing lecture, then bring a friend to Toll Library for the research discussion.
cards.short_summary: A free in-person talk about research methods in behavioral science.
cards.evidence_claim: The University calendar lists the Sept. 8 lecture at Newman Alumni Center's Toll Library as a Free Event.
cards.source_title: Latent Variable Modeling in the Behavioral Sciences | Yusuf Kara Lecture 9/8
cards.access_notes: Sept. 8, 2026, 4–6 p.m.; register through the event page. Location: 6200 San Amaro Dr.

cards.title: Explore AI Lawyering demos
cards.subtitle: Newman Alumni Center · Oct. 16, 2026
cards.notes: Reserve a place for the School of Law’s panels, hands-on workshops, and AI tool demonstrations at the Newman Alumni Center.
cards.short_summary: A free legal-tech conference with workshops and demonstrations.
cards.evidence_claim: The University calendar identifies this Oct. 16 conference at Newman Alumni Center as a Free Event.
cards.source_title: Prompting Legal Solutions: Conference & Competition
cards.access_notes: Oct. 16, 2026, 9 a.m.–4 p.m.; space is limited and registration is required. 6200 San Amaro Dr.

cards.entity_name: CEPS Lunch & Learn: Election Law and Voting Rights
cards.title: Join the election-law panel
cards.subtitle: Law Campus, F109 · Sept. 10, 2026
cards.notes: Register for the Center for Ethics and Public Service panel and arrive at F109 ready to listen and ask informed questions.
cards.short_summary: A free student-facing discussion of election law and voting rights.
cards.evidence_claim: The University calendar labels this CEPS panel at Law Campus F109 a Free Event and lists students as its audience.
cards.source_title: CEPS Lunch & Learn: Election Law and Voting Rights
cards.access_notes: Sept. 10, 2026, 12:20–1:40 p.m.; registration is requested. Location: 1311 Miller Rd.

cards.title: Spend time at Law Family Weekend
cards.subtitle: University of Miami School of Law · Sept. 24–26, 2026
cards.notes: Register with the law school and use the weekend’s campus programs to reconnect with your student and meet their UM community.
cards.short_summary: A free law-campus family program; football tickets are optional.
cards.evidence_claim: The University calendar lists Law Family Weekend as a Free Event and notes that Hurricanes football tickets are optional to purchase.
cards.source_title: Law Family Weekend 2026
cards.access_notes: Sept. 24–26, 2026 at 1311 Miller Rd. Registration closes Sept. 4; football tickets, if desired, cost extra.

cards.title: Drop into the MRED+U info session
cards.subtitle: Online · Sept. 1, 2026
cards.notes: Register for the School of Architecture’s virtual session to learn about the real-estate development and urbanism program and ask questions.
cards.short_summary: A free online University of Miami program-information session.
cards.evidence_claim: The University calendar lists the Sept. 1 MRED+U virtual information session as a Free Event.
cards.source_title: MRED+U Program Info Session - 09/01/2026 (6pm)
cards.access_notes: Virtual session on Sept. 1, 2026; register through the event page for access details.

cards.title: Take the sensory tree tour and concert
cards.subtitle: Gifford Arboretum Stone Circle · April 16, 2026
cards.notes: Watch the University calendar for future Arboretum programming; this listing paired a sensory tree tour with a free outdoor concert.
cards.short_summary: A University-listed free Arboretum tour and Frost music performance.
cards.evidence_claim: The University listed the 2026 Arbor Day celebration as a Free Event, including a Gifford Arboretum sensory tour and free concert.
cards.source_title: Arbor Day Concert and Celebration
cards.access_notes: This listed event occurred April 16, 2026 at the Arboretum Stone Circle, Cox Science Building; it is included as documented free programming, not a standing daily activity.

cards.entity_name: Green U Tour of the Coral Gables Campus
cards.title: Follow a Green U campus tour
cards.subtitle: Starts at Stanford Circle · July 7, 2026
cards.notes: Use this route as a prompt to seek future Green U tours, which visit sustainability sites including gardens, restoration work, and murals.
cards.short_summary: A documented free tour of named sustainability sites on campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The University listed the July 2026 Green U Coral Gables campus tour as a Free Event.
cards.source_title: Green U tour of the Coral Gables campus
cards.access_notes: This listed tour occurred July 7, 2026 and began at the Admission Office lobby, 1306 Stanford Dr.; look for a newly posted session.

cards.title: Help in the Sustainability Garden
cards.subtitle: Gifford Arboretum · July 2, 2026
cards.notes: Look for the next maintenance hour and bring a hat, tied shoes, and water bottle to help care for plots in the Sustainability Garden.
cards.short_summary: A documented free volunteer hour for hands-on campus garden care.
cards.evidence_claim: The University listed Garden Volunteering Hour as a Free Event for UM community members in the Gifford Arboretum Sustainability Garden.
cards.source_title: Garden Volunteering Hour
cards.access_notes: The cited monthly maintenance session occurred July 2, 2026. The listing welcomes UM community volunteers; verify the next date before visiting.

cards.title: Catch a Frost Horns performance
cards.subtitle: Newman Recital Hall · March 5, 2026
cards.notes: Monitor Frost’s calendar for the next Horns & Friends program, then meet at Newman Recital Hall for the ensemble’s mixed-genre set.
cards.short_summary: A documented free Frost School concert featuring horn music.
cards.evidence_claim: The University listed Frost Horns & Friends at Newman Recital Hall as FREE.
cards.source_title: Frost Horns & Friends
cards.access_notes: The cited performance occurred March 5, 2026 at 5513 San Amaro Dr.; confirm a future program date before making plans.

warnings: Four cards document past 2026 University events and direct readers to confirm a future recurrence; the remaining six are scheduled for September or October 2026. Registration or RSVP may be required even where attendance is free.

boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten distinct University of Miami library study environments, spanning collaborative areas, quiet floors, stack-tower seating, and specialty collections.

cards.entity_name: Otto G. Richter Library First Floor
cards.title: Richter Library First Floor
cards.subtitle: Collaborative study and computing area
cards.notes: Set up here for collaborative coursework or computer-based tasks; keep conversations considerate because this floor is not a designated quiet zone.
cards.short_summary: A central-library floor for collaborative work and general computing.
cards.evidence_claim: University of Miami Libraries identifies Richter Library's first floor for general computing, collaborative work, and group study rooms.
cards.source_title: Study Zones | University of Miami Libraries
cards.access_notes: Located in Richter Library; use the library's current operating hours and observe the zoned-noise policy.

cards.entity_name: Otto G. Richter Library Second Floor
cards.title: Richter Library Second Floor
cards.subtitle: Quiet individual-study floor
cards.notes: Choose an individual seat for focused reading or writing, silence your phone, and reserve any needed group room separately from the quiet floor.
cards.short_summary: A quiet Richter floor with individual study and limited computing.
cards.evidence_claim: University of Miami Libraries designates the entire Richter Library second floor as a quiet zone except for its group study rooms.
cards.source_title: Study Zones | University of Miami Libraries
cards.access_notes: Quiet-zone expectations apply; group study rooms are the stated exception.

cards.entity_name: Otto G. Richter Library Stack Tower Floor 4
cards.title: Richter Stack Tower, Floor 4
cards.subtitle: Quiet individual study beside A, PQ7298–PZ, Q–QG, and Z materials
cards.notes: Use this stack-tower floor for individual work near its assigned collections, with your phone silenced and conversation kept to a minimum.
cards.short_summary: A quiet stack-tower study floor paired with humanities and science call-number ranges.
cards.evidence_claim: University of Miami Libraries lists Richter Stack Tower floor 4 for quiet individual study and assigns several call-number ranges to that floor.
cards.source_title: Richter Library Stack Tower Guide | University of Miami Libraries
cards.access_notes: The Stack Tower is a quiet zone; follow library noise guidance while using individual seating.

cards.entity_name: Otto G. Richter Library Stack Tower Floor 5
cards.title: Richter Stack Tower, Floor 5
cards.subtitle: Quiet individual study beside JX–JZ, K, L, N, and P–PQ7297 materials
cards.notes: Bring a reading list and settle into individual work near the floor’s law, social-science, language, and literature shelving ranges.
cards.short_summary: A quiet stack-tower floor alongside multiple social-science and humanities collections.
cards.evidence_claim: University of Miami Libraries lists Richter Stack Tower floor 5 for quiet individual study and assigns JX–JZ, K, L, N, and P–PQ7297 materials there.
cards.source_title: Richter Library Stack Tower Guide | University of Miami Libraries
cards.access_notes: The Stack Tower is a quiet zone; follow library noise guidance while using individual seating.

cards.entity_name: Otto G. Richter Library Stack Tower Floor 6
cards.title: Richter Stack Tower, Floor 6
cards.subtitle: Quiet individual study beside F2200–FZ, G, H, J–JV, and Juvenile materials
cards.notes: Use the individual-study setting when working through sources from the floor’s history, geography, social-science, or juvenile collections.
cards.short_summary: A quiet stack-tower floor with history, geography, and social-science holdings nearby.
cards.evidence_claim: University of Miami Libraries lists Richter Stack Tower floor 6 for quiet individual study and assigns F2200–FZ, G, H, J–JV, and Juvenile materials there.
cards.source_title: Richter Library Stack Tower Guide | University of Miami Libraries
cards.access_notes: The Stack Tower is a quiet zone; follow library noise guidance while using individual seating.

cards.entity_name: Otto G. Richter Library Stack Tower Floor 7
cards.title: Richter Stack Tower, Floor 7
cards.subtitle: Quiet individual study beside B–BF311.O, C, D, E, and F1–F2199 materials
cards.notes: Use this quiet stack floor for sustained individual work, especially when your research draws on its philosophy, history, or geography ranges.
cards.short_summary: A quiet stack-tower floor adjacent to philosophy and history collections.
cards.evidence_claim: University of Miami Libraries lists Richter Stack Tower floor 7 for quiet individual study and assigns B–BF311.O, C, D, E, and F1–F2199 materials there.
cards.source_title: Richter Library Stack Tower Guide | University of Miami Libraries
cards.access_notes: The Stack Tower is a quiet zone; follow library noise guidance while using individual seating.

cards.entity_name: Otto G. Richter Library Stack Tower Floor 9
cards.title: Richter Stack Tower, Floor 9
cards.subtitle: Quiet individual study beside B–BF311.O and QH–Z materials
cards.notes: Plan a focused solo session near the floor’s psychology, science, technology, and bibliography holdings; keep devices on silent or vibrate.
cards.short_summary: A quiet stack-tower floor near psychology, science, and technology materials.
cards.evidence_claim: University of Miami Libraries lists Richter Stack Tower floor 9 for quiet individual study and assigns B–BF311.O and QH–Z materials there.
cards.source_title: Richter Library Stack Tower Guide | University of Miami Libraries
cards.access_notes: The Stack Tower is a quiet zone; follow library noise guidance while using individual seating.

cards.entity_name: Graduate Student Study Room, Richter Library Room 212
cards.title: Graduate Student Study Room 212
cards.subtitle: Richter Library second floor, northwest corner
cards.notes: Eligible graduate students can check out a carrel key card or lounge access card at Circulation, then use tables, carrels, computers, lockers, and printing.
cards.short_summary: An access-controlled graduate study room with carrels, tables, computers, lockers, and printing.
cards.evidence_claim: Richter Library Room 212 has 22 daily-checkout carrels, 12 study tables, computers, lockers, lounge chairs, and a printer/scanner/copier for eligible graduate students.
cards.source_title: Graduate Student Study Room | University of Miami Libraries
cards.access_notes: Exclusive to specified graduate students from the Gables and RSMAS campuses; access is arranged through the Richter Circulation Desk.

cards.title: Architecture Research Center
cards.subtitle: Paul Buisson Architecture Library
cards.notes: Book a study table or room up to one day ahead, or use the quiet library areas; keep drinks covered and leave food outside.
cards.short_summary: An architecture-library setting with bookable tables and rooms plus quiet study areas.
cards.evidence_claim: The Architecture Research Center offers rooms and study tables for booking, and University of Miami Libraries designates its non-seminar-room areas for quiet study.
cards.source_title: Room & Equipment Reservations | University of Miami Libraries
cards.access_notes: Study rooms and tables are bookable through the Library Calendar System; bookings may be made up to one day ahead.

cards.entity_name: Marta and Austin Weeks Music Library
cards.title: Weeks Music Library
cards.subtitle: At the edge of Lake Osceola on the Coral Gables campus
cards.notes: Use a quiet or low-level collaborative seat for research, then draw on the library’s playback equipment and computers when your project needs media tools.
cards.short_summary: A music-focused library with study seating, playback equipment, and research computers.
cards.evidence_claim: Weeks Music Library provides playback equipment, research computers, and quiet, comfortable places to study; its policy permits low-level collaborative conversation.
cards.source_title: Welcome to Weeks Music Library | University of Miami Libraries
cards.access_notes: Food and drink are not allowed; low-level, non-disruptive conversation is permitted under the library's noise policy.

boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named Coral Gables destinations on practical off-campus corridors, each paired with a directly documented reason to go.

cards.title: Shops at Merrick Park
cards.subtitle: San Lorenzo Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Walk the San Lorenzo Avenue frontage to browse the two-level outdoor center, then use its listed restaurants, shops, cinema, or gym as your reason to stop.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor retail center with several documented activity options.
cards.evidence_claim: The City lists Shops at Merrick Park at 358 San Lorenzo Avenue and identifies restaurants, boutiques, department stores, a movie theater, and a gym.
cards.source_title: Shops at Merrick Park | Coral Gables
cards.access_notes: At 358 San Lorenzo Ave.; listed hours are Monday–Saturday 11 a.m.–8 p.m. and Sunday noon–6 p.m.

cards.title: Books & Books
cards.subtitle: Aragon Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Head to 265 Aragon Avenue for the bookstore; check its events listing before you go if you want to pair browsing with a scheduled author program.
cards.short_summary: A named independent bookstore on Aragon Avenue.
cards.evidence_claim: Books & Books identifies its Coral Gables bookstore at 265 Aragon Avenue and publishes a location-specific events listing.
cards.source_title: Contact Us | Books & Books
cards.access_notes: The official contact page lists Coral Gables store hours through 11 p.m. most days; confirm event details separately.

cards.title: Coral Gables Art Cinema
cards.subtitle: Aragon Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Use the cinema schedule to choose a screening, then find the theater between Ponce de Leon Boulevard and Salzedo Street on Aragon Avenue.
cards.short_summary: A nonprofit cinema with a documented Aragon Avenue location.
cards.evidence_claim: Coral Gables Art Cinema states that it is at 260 Aragon Avenue, between Ponce de Leon Boulevard and Salzedo Street.
cards.source_title: Location and Parking - Gables Cinema
cards.access_notes: At 260 Aragon Ave.; the official page notes a covered garage next door and street parking nearby.

cards.title: Coral Gables Museum
cards.subtitle: Aragon Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Plan an exhibition or tour visit at the former police and fire station, using the museum’s programs to focus your walk through the Aragon Avenue block.
cards.short_summary: A museum centered on Coral Gables architecture, planning, and history.
cards.evidence_claim: The City says the Coral Gables Museum offers exhibitions, collections, educational offerings, lectures, tours, publications, and special events at 285 Aragon Avenue.
cards.source_title: Coral Gables Museum | Coral Gables
cards.access_notes: At 285 Aragon Ave.; the City lists wheelchair access, guided tours, and Wi‑Fi.

cards.entity_name: Actors' Playhouse at the Miracle Theatre
cards.title: Actors' Playhouse at the Miracle Theatre
cards.subtitle: Miracle Mile corridor
cards.notes: Pick a musical, drama, or children’s program from the theater calendar, then arrive via the Miracle Mile block with nearby street parking and garages.
cards.short_summary: A performing-arts destination on Miracle Mile.
cards.evidence_claim: Actors’ Playhouse lists its venue at 280 Miracle Mile and identifies nearby street parking and garages in the Miracle Mile area.
cards.source_title: Visit Us - Actors' Playhouse at the Miracle Theatre
cards.access_notes: At 280 Miracle Mile; box-office hours are published on the venue’s visit page and can change for productions.

cards.title: Giralda Plaza
cards.subtitle: Giralda Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Use the pedestrianized 100 block of Giralda Avenue as a short walking detour and choose among the documented restaurant or coffee-shop options there.
cards.short_summary: A pedestrian corridor lined with food and coffee businesses.
cards.evidence_claim: The City states that the 100 block of Giralda Avenue reopened as Giralda Plaza, a pedestrian walkway lined with restaurants, bars, and coffee shops.
cards.source_title: Giralda Plaza | Coral Gables
cards.access_notes: The City identifies this as the 100 block of Giralda Ave.; select an all-ages restaurant or coffee shop.

cards.title: Venetian Pool
cards.subtitle: De Soto Boulevard corridor
cards.notes: Reserve or check same-day availability before heading to De Soto Boulevard, then swim among the pool’s spring water, waterfalls, and cave-like grottos.
cards.short_summary: A public historic pool supplied by an underground aquifer.
cards.evidence_claim: The City says Venetian Pool is fed by spring water from an underground aquifer and features two waterfalls and cave-like grottos.
cards.source_title: Venetian Pool | Coral Gables
cards.access_notes: At 2701 De Soto Blvd.; admission is ticketed, capacity can limit same-day entry, and alcohol is not permitted.

cards.title: The Biltmore Hotel
cards.subtitle: Anastasia Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Walk the Anastasia Avenue approach to see the Mediterranean-style hotel architecture, then use the listed golf, tennis, spa, fitness, or dining facilities if desired.
cards.short_summary: A 1926-era landmark hotel with multiple documented facilities.
cards.evidence_claim: The City describes the Biltmore as a 271-room resort on more than 150 acres with Mediterranean architecture, golf, tennis, spa, fitness, and pool facilities.
cards.source_title: The Biltmore Hotel | Coral Gables
cards.access_notes: At 1200 Anastasia Ave.; access to facilities and services may require a reservation or purchase.

cards.title: Matheson Hammock Park & Marina
cards.subtitle: Old Cutler Road corridor
cards.notes: Use the Old Cutler Road entrance for a nature-trail or picnic outing, and look for the tidal atoll pool and marina rather than treating the park as a pass-through.
cards.short_summary: A 630-acre park with trails, an atoll pool, and a marina.
cards.evidence_claim: The City identifies Matheson Hammock as a 630-acre urban park with a tidal atoll pool, marina, picnic pavilions, and nature trails.
cards.source_title: Matheson Hammock Park & Marina | Coral Gables
cards.access_notes: At 9610 Old Cutler Road; the City lists vehicle entrance fees and daily hours of 8 a.m.–5 p.m.

cards.title: Fairchild Tropical Botanic Garden
cards.subtitle: Old Cutler Road corridor
cards.notes: Buy admission for a daytime walk through the garden’s tropical plant collections, then add the Wings of the Tropics butterfly exhibit to your route.
cards.short_summary: An 83-acre garden with tropical collections and a butterfly exhibit.
cards.evidence_claim: Fairchild states that it is at 10901 Old Cutler Road, is open daily 10 a.m.–5 p.m., and includes collections, exhibits, and Wings of the Tropics.
cards.source_title: Visit Fairchild Tropical Botanic Garden
cards.access_notes: At 10901 Old Cutler Road; general admission is required for non-members and the garden is open daily except December 25.

boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Ten documented University of Miami rituals, from the Lake Osceola boat burn to Sebastian’s graduation reveal.

cards.title: Watch the Boat Burn at Lake Osceola
cards.subtitle: Homecoming • Lake Osceola
cards.notes: Attend the Homecoming boat-burning ceremony from the Lake Osceola viewing area. The official account records its 1956 start and the mast-fall game-day legend.
cards.short_summary: A student-led Homecoming fire ritual with a football omen attached.
cards.evidence_claim: University of Miami describes the boat-burning ceremony as a student-led tradition passed down since 1956; its legend says a mast that falls before the boat sinks predicts a Hurricanes Homecoming win.
cards.source_title: Boat Burning Ceremony and Fireworks Show
cards.access_notes: Occurs as part of University Homecoming programming; consult the current Homecoming schedule for attendance details.

cards.title: Join the Hurricane Howl
cards.subtitle: Homecoming • Coral Gables Campus
cards.notes: Look for Hurricane Howl on the Homecoming schedule, then stay for the linked boat-burning and fireworks traditions. It is documented in University coverage of Homecoming.
cards.short_summary: A Homecoming rally tradition that leads into Lake Osceola festivities.
cards.evidence_claim: University of Miami’s Frost School publication identifies Hurricane Howl, boat burning, and the Homecoming fireworks display as traditional festivities.
cards.source_title: The Score, Spring 2022
cards.access_notes: Presented during Homecoming; confirm the current year’s date and location through University event listings.

cards.title: Spot the Iron Arrow Tapping Procession
cards.subtitle: Iron Arrow Honor Society • Coral Gables Campus
cards.notes: If a public campus procession is announced, observe respectfully from open areas. The society’s documented tapping practice recognizes members chosen for five stated qualities.
cards.short_summary: A ceremonial selection ritual for the University’s highest honor society.
cards.evidence_claim: University of Miami documentation says Iron Arrow members assemble twice yearly to select tappees, then conduct a drum-accompanied procession and tap each new member with the Iron Arrow.
cards.source_title: University of Miami Medical Campus Tour
cards.access_notes: Membership and ceremonies are society-administered; view only where the procession is publicly accessible.

cards.entity_name: University of Miami Class Ring Ceremony
cards.title: Recite the Ring Oath
cards.subtitle: Class Ring Ceremony • Coral Gables Campus
cards.notes: Ring recipients can follow Alumni Association instructions for the annual ceremony, ring processional, Ring Oath, and reception. Guest eligibility is set by the event.
cards.short_summary: An annual spring ritual for recipients of the University’s official ring.
cards.evidence_claim: A University of Miami program describes the official Class Ring Ceremony as an annual spring event where recipients receive rings, join a processional, and recite the Ring Oath.
cards.source_title: The Miami Hurricane, April 2013 issue
cards.access_notes: For ring recipients and invited guests; confirm current eligibility, registration, and ring purchase requirements with the Alumni Association.

cards.title: Mark Graduation at Senior Mwambo
cards.subtitle: Multicultural Student Affairs • Shalala Student Center
cards.notes: Graduating students and families can check the University calendar for the Senior Mwambo ceremony, a rite-of-passage celebration established at UM in 1992.
cards.short_summary: A University-specific graduation rite honoring community, culture, and transition.
cards.evidence_claim: University of Miami calls Senior Mwambo a longstanding tradition, established in 1992, that honors graduates’ achievements, heritage, and transition to advanced study and professional life.
cards.source_title: UMBAS | Senior Mwambo with Multicultural Student Affairs
cards.access_notes: For graduating students, families, and invited community members; use the University calendar for the next ceremony’s details.

cards.title: See Sebastian’s Seniors Reveal Themselves
cards.subtitle: Commencement • Sebastian the Ibis
cards.notes: Watch commencement closely: graduating student performers traditionally cross the stage in Sebastian’s oversized Ibis feet, publicly revealing their mascot role.
cards.short_summary: The people inside the mascot suit wait until graduation to step into view.
cards.evidence_claim: University of Miami Athletics reports that a tradition developed in which Sebastian performers reveal their identities at graduation by walking across the stage in Ibis feet and jersey.
cards.source_title: Being Sebastian
cards.access_notes: Visible during commencement ceremonies; attendance and guest procedures are set by the University’s commencement office.

cards.title: Learn the C-A-N-E-S Spell-Out
cards.subtitle: Hurricanes sporting events • Sebastian the Ibis
cards.notes: At a Hurricanes event, follow Sebastian and the crowd through the five-letter C-A-N-E-S spell-out. Athletics traces the ritual to the Miami Maniac era.
cards.short_summary: A body-letter cheer that Sebastian adopted and still performs at Hurricanes events.
cards.evidence_claim: University of Miami Athletics states that Sebastian the Ibis adopted the C-A-N-E-S spell-out, a ritual that still stands at Hurricanes sporting events.
cards.source_title: Birth of a Maniac
cards.access_notes: Join only where event staff permit fan participation; game tickets or venue admission may be required.

cards.title: Start at ’Cane Kickoff
cards.subtitle: New-student orientation • Coral Gables Campus
cards.notes: Incoming first-year and transfer students should use orientation instructions for Cane Kickoff, the University’s signature program for beginning a UM experience.
cards.short_summary: The University’s official welcome week for new Canes.
cards.evidence_claim: University of Miami identifies Cane Kickoff as its signature orientation program for first-year and transfer students and says it introduces new students to campus traditions.
cards.source_title: Cane Kickoff 2025: Welcome to the U
cards.access_notes: Intended for incoming students; follow Orientation and Commuter Student Involvement directions for required sessions and registration.

cards.title: Rub the U Before a Big Moment
cards.subtitle: The U Statue • The Rock, Coral Gables Campus
cards.notes: Stop at the orange-and-green U statue by the Rock before an exam, interview, or game if you want to take part in the student good-luck custom.
cards.short_summary: A campus statue became a luck ritual immediately after its Homecoming unveiling.
cards.evidence_claim: The Miami Hurricane reported that, after the U statue’s 2012 Homecoming unveiling, students were encouraged to rub it for good luck before exams, athletic events, interviews, and other important occasions.
cards.source_title: Statue revealed at Homecoming opening ceremonies
cards.access_notes: Outdoor campus landmark; respect the surrounding grounds and any temporary access controls.

cards.title: Watch the Canes Run Through the Smoke
cards.subtitle: Miami Hurricanes football • Hard Rock Stadium
cards.notes: Arrive before kickoff for the football team’s smoke-tunnel entrance. University Athletics describes the white-smoke run as a famed Miami football tradition.
cards.short_summary: A pregame team entrance through a cloud of white smoke.
cards.evidence_claim: University of Miami Athletics describes running through the smoke as a Miami football tradition and reported in 2023 that Hurricanes players were preparing to return through the famed white smoke at Hard Rock Stadium.
cards.source_title: It’s the Beginning of a Long Journey
cards.access_notes: A football game ticket and stadium entry are generally required; arrive before kickoff because the entrance occurs pregame.

boards.title: Your First Weekend at University of Miami, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A conservative, under-21-safe sequence for getting oriented through named Coral Gables campus spaces and public cultural programming.

cards.title: Start with the official self-guided route
cards.subtitle: Friday arrival · 1306 Stanford Drive
cards.notes: Register if required, then use the University’s self-guided tour map to make a first pass through campus at your own pace.
cards.short_summary: Begin with an official framework for learning the Coral Gables campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The Office of Undergraduate Admission offers a self-guided walking tour and directs visitors to a digital campus map.
cards.source_title: Self-Guided Tour | University of Miami Office of Undergraduate Admission
cards.access_notes: The source says registration is required and notes that some campus areas may be closed on weekends.

cards.title: Find the student-services hub
cards.subtitle: Friday · campus orientation stop
cards.notes: Walk through the Student Center to locate student-organization and Student Life offices before you need an appointment or event space.
cards.short_summary: A named center for student organizations, lounges, meetings, and campus services.
cards.evidence_claim: The University’s self-guided tour identifies the Shalala Student Center as housing student-organization offices, lounge spaces, meeting rooms, and Student Life departments.
cards.source_title: University of Miami Self-Guided Tour Booklet
cards.access_notes: Access and room availability vary; consult the center or event calendar for a particular activity.

cards.title: Take the lakeside campus walk
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · beside the Shalala Student Center
cards.notes: Use the lake as a visual waypoint while connecting the Student Center, University Center area, and nearby academic buildings on foot.
cards.short_summary: A named lake setting along the Student Center portion of campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The University’s Coral Gables campus tour describes the Shalala Student Center as being set along Lake Osceola.
cards.source_title: Coral Gables Campus Tour | University of Miami
cards.access_notes: This is an outdoor campus stop; follow posted campus guidance and use established paths.

cards.title: Locate the central library early
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · 1300 Memorial Drive
cards.notes: Step inside Richter to identify the central library’s service points and make a note of where to return when coursework begins.
cards.short_summary: The Coral Gables campus’s central interdisciplinary library.
cards.evidence_claim: Richter Library is the University of Miami’s central interdisciplinary library on the Coral Gables campus.
cards.source_title: Richter Library | University of Miami Libraries
cards.access_notes: Library access, services, and hours can change; check the library’s current information before visiting.

cards.title: See the archives and Special Collections home
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · Richter Library, 1300 Memorial Drive
cards.notes: Visit the first-floor Kislak Center to recognize its reading room and gallery, then save its collections for a future research project.
cards.short_summary: A campus center for Special Collections, University Archives, and the Kislak Collection.
cards.evidence_claim: The Kislak Center brings together Special Collections and University Archives with the Kislak Collection in Richter Library.
cards.source_title: About | Kislak Center at the University of Miami
cards.access_notes: Research services and gallery access are subject to library policies and current hours.

cards.title: Build in an art-gallery pause
cards.subtitle: Saturday daytime · 1301 Stanford Drive
cards.notes: Check the museum’s current visitor information, then give yourself time to view galleries without trying to rush the entire collection.
cards.short_summary: An on-campus art museum spanning thousands of years of human creativity.
cards.evidence_claim: The Lowe Art Museum offers audiences resources for engaging with contemporary culture through 5,000 years of human creativity.
cards.source_title: Lowe Art Museum | University of Miami
cards.access_notes: Confirm current gallery hours, admission terms, and any ticketed-program details directly with the museum.

cards.entity_name: Patti and Allan Herbert Wellness Center
cards.title: Get acquainted with recreation options
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon · Coral Gables campus
cards.notes: Bring your Cane Card and check the facility’s current procedures before planning a workout, court time, swim, or recreation activity.
cards.short_summary: A campus fitness, recreation, and wellness facility with varied indoor and outdoor amenities.
cards.evidence_claim: The Herbert Wellness Center includes fitness, recreation, and wellness facilities such as a fitness room, pool, courts, track, and studios.
cards.source_title: Coral Gables Campus Tour | University of Miami
cards.access_notes: A valid University of Miami ID is required for use; membership or other access conditions may apply.

cards.title: Check the cinema’s next screening
cards.subtitle: Saturday evening · 5030 Brunson Drive
cards.notes: Look at the cinema schedule and choose a listed screening that fits your weekend; confirm ticketing and start time before heading over.
cards.short_summary: A single-screen campus art-house cinema that hosts films, festivals, and filmmakers.
cards.evidence_claim: Bill Cosford Cinema is a single-screen art-house cinema serving the University of Miami and greater Miami, with film programming and educational events.
cards.source_title: Bill Cosford Cinema | University of Miami Events Calendar
cards.access_notes: Screenings, times, and ticket requirements differ by program; use the current cinema listing.

cards.title: Look for a Frost performance
cards.subtitle: Saturday evening · 1314 Miller Drive
cards.notes: Browse the Frost calendar for a listed concert at Gusman Concert Hall, then verify the program, time, and ticket terms before attending.
cards.short_summary: A named campus concert hall used for Frost School of Music performances.
cards.evidence_claim: University event listings place Frost School of Music performances at Gusman Concert Hall, 1314 Miller Drive.
cards.source_title: 2026 Stamps Jazz Quintet & Frost Sextet | University of Miami Events
cards.access_notes: Programs are event-specific; verify the current Frost listing for availability, age guidance, and cost.

cards.title: Save a recital hall for Sunday
cards.subtitle: Sunday · Knight Center for Music Innovation, 5513 San Amaro Drive
cards.notes: Use the current events calendar to see whether a Newman Recital Hall performance is scheduled, then plan around its published details.
cards.short_summary: A Knight Center recital venue used for Frost chamber and choral performances.
cards.evidence_claim: University event listings identify Newman Recital Hall at the Knight Center for Music Innovation as a venue for Frost performances.
cards.source_title: Frost Chamber Music Showcase IV | University of Miami Events
cards.access_notes: The cited showcase was a dated event; consult the current calendar for future programming and entry terms.
